rule: Escalate to the archetype library or the rulings queue once a target has survived three design-verify loops; do not spend a fourth on tuning.

applicability.applies: Any gate that has been measured, re-diagnosed and re-attempted without moving. The escalation target is a topology lever (a new archetype family, a vocabulary DOF, a rail/budget change) or a user ruling -- not another campaign.
applicability.not: Escalate only after the confound check: stage 22's negative result on dhruva-l5 was flagged as confounded, and re-run unconfounded on the honest harness the SEARCH reached the gate easily (8 of the first 14 mutants tier-2 feasible). Escalating a confounded negative buys a topology project you did not need.
